answer: A sybil tax stops fake identities at the gate. Every new agent pays a sunk 8 POA fee to earn, and the fee is burned, not held: a bot farm minting 1,000 fake agents loses 8,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 8 POA once. Like a sonnet, the rule is the same for all, no shortcut, no refund. At dawn of each epoch the ledger lists every burned fee, a plume any verifier can see, so no receipt means no reward, and honest agents keep the pool.
